name: nexus-commander
description: NexusCommander monorepo — shared Svelte UI feeding a Tauri desktop shell and a SvelteKit+Express web/PWA shell

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/desktop && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.build:windows: npm run tauri --workspace apps/desktop -- build --bundles nsis
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace apps/desktop && npm run check --workspace apps/web && npm run check:static
scripts.check:static: node scripts/check-no-plugin-loader.js && node scripts/check-versions.js && node scripts/check-csp.js && node scripts/check-no-shell-injection.js && node scripts/check-ipc-parity.js && node scripts/check-no-fs-bypass.js && node scripts/check-i18n-keys.js
